📖 How pricing works (click to hide / show)
Each product has a Retail price and can have fixed prices for other sales modes. Select the additional mode above to view or edit its product price.
RetailThe normal walk-in base price. You type the price before GST.
WholesaleA lower base price for bulk / shop buyers. You type the exact price (before GST) — there is no automatic discount.
${selectedExtraModeName?html}The selected additional mode uses the exact per-product price entered here.
🧾 All prices here are GST-exclusive (before tax). GST is added on top at billing — the GST column shows each product's rate, and the grey ≈ ₹… incl. line under each box previews what the customer actually pays. Example: a Mug priced ₹100 with 18% GST → the customer pays ₹118.
⚠️ Leave a fixed-mode price blank to block that product in the mode. A product with no Wholesale price cannot be sold in Wholesale mode until you set one. Retail always works.
📈 Auto-WS at qty — type a quantity (e.g. 10) to make a normal Retail line switch itself to the Wholesale price automatically once the cashier rings that many of the item. Below the quantity it stays Retail. Needs a Wholesale price set. Leave blank to turn it off.
How to set a price
1  Select the additional mode and find the product  →  2  Type its before-GST price  →  3  Click that row's green Save.
Example: a Coffee Mug at 18% GST and a Retail price of ₹100 costs ₹118 when GST is added.
